segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, acne-prone cheeks reports the treatment worked unusually fast on hyperpigmentation and absorbed smoothly despite expecting it to suit oily skin better.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe burning, chemical-burn-like reactions, peeling, or rashes, including one who reacted specifically where glasses touched treated skin.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 40s with brown spots and long-accumulated scarring saw no results despite twice-daily use, while others using it for age/sun spots report gradual lightening.
segments.combination: One reviewer who is oily in summer and breakout-prone on the forehead, nose and chin reports clearer, smoother, less bumpy skin with continued use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for sunspots or age spots report gradual fading over weeks; one long-time user still has hope but has not seen full disappearance yet.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers note the product dries out skin, especially on the chin, and one reports peeling and flaking that required extra moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness and calmer skin after weeks of use, though one reviewer's chemical-burn reaction included painful redness and bleeding.
concerns.barrier: A minority describe chemical burns, itching, bleeding, or rash-like breakdown of the skin, sometimes tied to specific spots like where glasses sit; others report no irritation at all over extended use.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report dark spots, sunspots and hyperpigmentation fading, sometimes within days; a few say pigment shrank but never fully disappeared.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers with active acne report fewer or lighter blemishes and faster healing of pimples; a smaller number report new breakouts or no change at all.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports her acne and oil control improved when paired with a gel moisturizer; no separate complaints of increased oiliness from the treatment itself.

aspects.libelle: Difficult to layer under other products

extraits.texte: When i first started using this it made my skin so much better. I had no breakouts and my acne scars were going away. However after using it for a couple weeks I ended up with a chemical burn. My skin was red, bleeding, and itched a lot. The next day my skin was completely dried out and started to peel. It's gotten better but is still peeling and still burns.

I have very old acne scarring from when I was a teen on my cheeks, relatively smooth skin everywhere else. used this just on those areas and woke up to peeling skin with breakouts and a mild chemical burn. 100% not worth it. Been seeing an esthetician and my results with her peels have been MUCH better.

extraits.titre: Had High Hopes & Wanted to Love
extraits.texte: I've been using this 2x/day & no results. It pills after I put it on. It's nice & thick so it glides on easy & makes your skin very soft. I'm in my 40s & have horrible brown spots on my jawline from ear to ear. Makeup doesn't even cover them & I've tried tons! I get acne & cystic acne each month ecactly 2 weeks before my period starts. When I'm out in the sun, I get very dark so my tone evens out a little. I've just accumulated so many scars over the years that nothing has helped. What works for one may not work for another so don't let this dissuade you from buying this product. I'm still going to try their other products because you never know!

extraits.titre: This will ALWAYS be in my daily routine!
extraits.texte: This product has been a complete game changer for me. I suffered from horrible acne as an adolescent and have consistently struggled with picking my skin, causing acne scars to be a recurring problem for me. I'd tried so many scar treatments to no avail, but once I tried this, my scars started fading within a few weeks. I have incredibly acne prone skin, but I personally have never had a breakout from using this product. I do have to agree with the reviewers who point out the fact that the texture is inconsistent and that it can tend to pill once you get to a certain point in the bottle, but in my experience, this hasn't affected the outcome of results at all. This is definitely one of my all time faves!

So I've been struggling with cystic acne on my back/chest/shoulders along with breakouts on my face. These breakouts always scar. It doesn't matter if i pick at them or not, whitehead volcano or not...there's always a scar left behind. No other treatment has ever worked in the past (antibiotics, topicals, prescription soaps, switching laundry detergents, changed diet, salicylic acid washes don't even help with my chest/back/shoulder area). SO now i'm taking Myorisan. Now that my acne is slowly starting to clear up, i have more scars and they're not pretty. I asked a worker at Ulta which acne scar treatment he recommends and he took me straight to the Murad stuff. Him and I weren't sure if it was going to be too much while on Myorisan but so far I haven't had any problems. I've been using it twice a day for the last 5 days and I already see a huge difference, some of the scars actually disappeared after 3 days of treating them. And an added bonus, it has a nice smell and it's not overwhelming.

I was SHOCKED by how well this treatment worked for my skin. I have dry skin, but it is also super acne prone in my cheek area. I find this to be a super unique problem, because mostly acne products are made for oily skin types, and hence a lot don't work on me. To top it off, I'm South Asian and suffer from hyperpigmentation and dark spots left by acne. This treatment had a difference in just a few days of using (unusual for products like these on the market that usually take upto 2-3 weeks to start showing results)! It absorbed really nicely into my skin and went on super smooth. It is a little bit on the pricier side, but well worth it - in my opinion. I love that it comes with a pump - that makes it really easy to not get any bacteria into the product itself. 10/10 would recommend this for people who suffer from acne and dark spots/hyperpigmentation.

Honestly, I think vitamin C is overrated. I hate vitamin c serum with those glass bottle dropper thingy. It's always oxidized before i finish the bottle. Love the pump packaging. The texture is not like anything I've seen before kinda like quicksand. Did a wonderful job fading hyperpigmentation. I wouldn't buy this again just because I don't like the fragrance and vitamin c. I usually opt for something more stable and gentler than this for hyperpigmentation.
